title: CASE-01 — Net-90 PO clamped to the 45-day cap, delay priced at 16.50%
note: INPUT ONLY, synthetic (golden rule 11): no real parties, Udyam or GSTIN numbers. No outputs are stored here; every number comes from the engine.
why_calculation_date: Deliberate, per architecture.md section 12: calculation_date is 2026-04-15, which sits inside the 5.50% Bank Rate epoch, so this delay must show 16.50% (3 x 5.50) and NOT the 17.25% v2 printed for the same period. Choosing a date after 2026-10-07 would show 17.25% and split the ledger across epochs instead. delivery_date is 2026-02-16 so that the appointed day (2026-04-03, i.e. delivery + 45 clamped days + 1) falls on or after 2026-04-01, the earliest epoch the config holds: Bank Rate epochs before that date are not captured yet (V1 uncaptured, CR-8), so an earlier delay cannot be priced at all.
